title: Mobility options for leisure road trips
intro: Soft CTAs for established Dutch car-sharing and complementary rail or bike options when a multi-stop leisure drive needs four wheels — or a train reset. Confirm live products on each site — this block is not a ranking of routes, destinations, rental cars or tour operators. Deepen fleet access on Car sharing; deepen ownership on Buying a car; deepen OV weekends on Weekend travel.

items.reason: Shared cars for occasional multi-stop leisure drives, coastal last miles or countryside loops when owning a car is not worth it yet — deepen fleets and membership habits on Car sharing.
Dutch Railways tickets and planners when part of the trip is better by train — open Weekend travel for leisure OV planning depth.
Maintained subscription bike for local hops around a base city between road-trip weekends — deepen fleets on Bike sharing.
